purpose: Frozen pre-zoo DFlash reference for the algorithm-zoo refactor (GOAL section 1). Numbers mirror BENCHMARKS.md; run dirs live on the training server (runs/ is gitignored). After any refactor, re-measure the gate rows (sequential verification only) and append the result to remeasurements.

metric_definitions.al: AL = new_tokens / target_verification_steps (bonus-token-inclusive tokens per target forward)
metric_definitions.per_slot_acceptance: accepted(k) / opportunities(k), k = 1..block_size-1; slot 0 is the clean anchor and is never supervised
metric_definitions.token_exact: speculative (draft + verify) greedy output equals target-only greedy output token-for-token; sequential verification, batch 1, same dtype/attn

checkpoint_semantics.ckpt_final.pt: trained drafter; stores algorithm + head (tied/untied) tags plus the feature-identity bindings; train/eval hard-fail on mismatch

feature_semantics.capture_v2_marker: stores_final_hidden: true - needed by the exact staged teacher used by JetSpec/DFlash2; DSpark/Domino/DFlash2 2K runs reuse runs/qwen25vl3b_jetspec_2k/features
feature_semantics.tied_head: features/target_head.pt is stored only when the target is untied; tied targets project through the embedding matrix

regression_gates: token_exact stays true for every gate row (hard gate; sequential verification only)
AL moves only within the recorded run-to-run noise (~2% bf16)
per-slot acceptance profile shape unchanged (slot 1 dominates, anchor never supervised)
ckpt_final/ckpt_init load from the frozen run and reproduce the recorded AL on the frozen eval prompts
the drafter visual-path check still passes (captured features carry image information)

after the DFlash2 stage landed; bit-identical to registry_check
full canonical re-eval of the frozen checkpoint with post-DFlash2 code; reproduces the frozen 1.6298365840801265 bit-identically (ckpt_init 1.0030, both token-exact)
